summary: Negotiate peer session detail and three-field subagent child IDs before dispatch, preserving old child links and showing explicit host-upgrade guidance instead of an unavailable conversation.

compatibility.detail: The signed peer client-read discovery advertises session-detail-child-id version 1. Missing support returns typed peer-too-old without probing an older operation decoder. New gateways read old two-field links; writers emit only three-field IDs.

manual.detail: Update a peer only when subagent conversation access on that peer is needed.
